title: Fake sites in search in practice
intro: The first result is not always right. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Searching for the Gorush app
decisions.prompt: You search for the Gorush app. Which result do you open?

artifact.title: Search: gorus yukle
body: gorus.example: Gorush, official site. Download for Windows and phone.

decisions.explain: The ad leads to another site; the app's own site is the result below it.

decisions.title: Searching for the citizen portal
decisions.prompt: You search for the citizen portal. Which result do you open?

artifact.title: Search: vetendas portali arayis
body: Sponsored · vetendasportal-gov.example: Vatandash Portal, official site

decisions.explain: The ad leads to a look-alike; the official result is the one whose address ends in gov.az.

decisions.title: Gorush download page
decisions.prompt: The ad opened this page, which looks like the real site. Look at the address. What do you do?

artifact.title: Gorush: free download
body: Video meetings for everyone. Download GorusSetup_2026.exe.

decisions.explain: The address was not the app's own site. Go to the official site yourself.

decisions.title: Citizen portal sign-in on a phone
decisions.prompt: On a phone only the start of the address shows. Read it to the end. What do you do?

artifact.title: Vatandash Portal
body: Vatandash Portal. Sign in with your FIN code.

decisions.explain: The real owner of a site is at the end of the address, and this one did not end in gov.az.

decisions.title: Downloaded Gorush installer
decisions.prompt: The file has downloaded. Will you open it?
decisions.explain: Delete the file, tell technical support, and get the app from the official site.
